instruction: Find the row with the largest negative Difference value (most under budget) and highlight the entire row in red background color.

metadata.explanation: Largest negative difference is -3723 at row 11. Verified with Python. Evaluator checks if row 11 has red fill color with fuzzy matching.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical: Instruction requires 'red background color' but evaluator only checks if row has ANY fill color, not specifically red
Getter extracts only 'has_fill' boolean, does not extract actual color values (RGB/hex)
Metric compares only 'has_fill' boolean, does not verify color is red
Options 'strict_color_match' and 'color_tolerance' are defined but never used in getter or metric
Evaluator would incorrectly pass if row is highlighted in blue, green, yellow, or any other color
Incomplete verification: does not validate the actual color requirement specified in instruction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify getter to extract actual RGB/hex color values from cell.fill.fgColor or cell.fill.bgColor
Modify metric to compare extracted color against red color values (e.g., RGB 255,0,0 or similar)
Use the color_tolerance option to allow fuzzy color matching (e.g., RGB values within tolerance of red)
Expected value should specify red color criteria (e.g., {'has_fill': true, 'color_rgb': [255, 0, 0]} or similar)
Consider using existing color comparison utilities if available in the codebase
